Welcome Home!

Join us every Sunday for worship at 9:00 AM

A Word From Our Pastor

Welcome to the Cedar Hollow Community Church website! Whether you have been part of our church family for years or you are visiting for the very first time, we are so glad you stopped by. Cedar Hollow has been serving the Millbrook community since 1978, and our doors are always open.

We hope you will come and visit us soon. Our worship service begins at 9:00 AM every Sunday morning, followed by Sunday School for all ages at 10:30 AM. Come as you are!

Blessings,
Pastor Dan Whitfield

About Us

Cedar Hollow Community Church is a small, friendly congregation of about 110 people. We are a family of believers who love to worship together, serve our neighbors, and share a meal whenever we get the chance! Our annual Fall Festival and Christmas Cantata are favorite traditions in Millbrook.

Ministries

Children's Ministry (Nursery – 5th Grade)
Nursery is available during the worship service. Kids' Sunday School meets in the Children's Wing.
Youth Group (Grades 6–12)
Sunday evenings at 6:00 PM in the Youth Room. Led by Pastor Kyle.
College & Young Adults
Contact the church office for details.
Women's Bible Study
Tuesday mornings at 10:00 AM in the Library.
Men's Breakfast
First Saturday of the month, 8:00 AM, Fellowship Hall.
Music Ministry
Choir practice Wednesdays. New voices always welcome!
